# Javier Alvarez-Valle

> Director of AI at Quotient Therapeutics in Cambridge, UK. Healthcare AI leader: multimodal foundation models for radiology, radiotherapy AI used in the NHS, and AI for drug discovery. Previously Senior Director at Microsoft Research Health Futures.

Javier has spent about 20 years building AI and large-scale systems, 13 of them at Microsoft. For 10 years at Microsoft Research he worked on AI for medicine: he led Project InnerEye (radiotherapy AI that cut contouring time by 36–67% in NHS use, open-sourced and adopted by 30+ organisations) and AI engineering for cancer treatment through FDA 510(k) clearance. As Senior Director in Health Futures he led a multidisciplinary team across continents building multimodal foundation models, with partners in three areas: radiology (Project MAIRA, deploying draft chest X-ray reports with Mayo Clinic), cancer screening with Cyted, and medical imaging in clinical trials with Novartis. He has 20+ peer-reviewed papers in venues including Nature, JAMA, CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS and EMNLP. He is also known as Javier Alvarez Valle and Javier Álvarez-Valle.

## Career

- 2026–present: Director of AI, Quotient Therapeutics (a Flagship Pioneering company using somatic genomics to discover medicines)
- 2026: Health and life sciences AI advisor (GradientWise): autonomous chest X-ray reporting; knowledge-base layer of the open-source Firefly Agentic framework
- 2022–2026: Senior Director, Microsoft Research Health Futures (Project MAIRA)
- 2015–2022: Microsoft Research (Project InnerEye, FDA 510(k))
- 2012–2015: Microsoft (Skype real-time telemetry, scaled across Xbox, Bing and Office)
- 2007–2012: Telefónica I+D, Redgate, Citrix, Featurespace
- Education: Computer Science, Universidad de Oviedo; MSc thesis at the University of Cambridge
